children: Shares of Aegis Logistics Ltd. are in focus on Tuesday, November 16, after the company closed its fund raising exercise through the Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP), through which it has raised ₹3,500 crore.

The company's fund raising committee has approved the issuance and allotment of 2.89 crore equity shares to 33 eligible qualified institutional buyers, Aegis Logistics' exchange filing said. The issue price of ₹1,210 per share, which is a discount of 1.8% from Monday's closing price.

Post the allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of Aegis Logistics stands at ₹37.99 crore comprising of 37.99 lakh equity shares from the previous ₹35.1 crore consisting of 35.1 lakh equity shares.
Aegis Logistics had launched the QIP issue on Wednesday, November 11.

At the end of the September quarter promoter entities held 58.1% stake in Aegis Logistics, while public shareholders comprised 41.8%. Of these, Smallcap World Fund Inc held 2.54% stake and Quant Mutual Fund - Quant Small Cap Fund, held 2.57% stake in the company.

On November 12, sources told CNBC-TV18 that the proposed QIP was expected to result in an equity dilution of around 7.1% of the firm's pre-issue outstanding share capital, based on the indicative issue price of ₹1,210 apiece.

The proposed capital raise is aimed at providing the company with greater financial flexibility to manage its debt obligations while also meeting its incremental working capital requirements, sources added.
Shares of Aegis Logistics ended the previous session 0.6% higher at ₹1,232 apiece. The stock has fallen 7.5% in the past month but has gained 72.7% in 2026, so far.

title: Aegis Logistics closes ₹3,600 crore QIP - 80% of shares issued to four major funds
